definitions.gloss: main house; main building (of a property)
definitions.explanation: The principal building of a house or farmstead, where the family lives, as against a detached annex ({離|はな}れ), storehouse or barn on the same grounds.

examples.japanese: {母屋|おもや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Go back to the main house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{母屋|おもや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: My grandparents live in the main house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離|はな}れ→離れ：33496_hanare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{母屋|おもや}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{渡|わた}り→渡り：13621_watari⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つながって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A covered walkway connects the annex to the main house.

notes:
WRITING:
- Also written {母家|おもや}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{庇|ひさし}→庇：16002_hisashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧{母屋|おもや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧: lend someone the eaves and lose the whole house; a small favour that ends with losing everything

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{離|はな}れ→離れ：33496_hanare⟧: a detached room or annex on the same grounds
- ⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧: the main building of a hotel, school or hospital, as against its annexes
